prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: Create a dynamic, high-energy scene featuring three young women with striking, bright turquoise bob haircuts, captured mid-motion as their hair whips dramatically through the air. Each woman wears oversized, crisp white t-shirts with subtle silver text and loose white pants, creating a monochromatic, futuristic look. Their expressions are confident and slightly playful, exuding a sense of individuality and cool detachment. The background is a seamless, soft white studio space, free of distractions, emphasizing the subjects and their synchronized movement. The lighting is bright, even, and diffused, eliminating harsh shadows and giving the image a clean, almost ethereal quality. The camera angle is straight-on at eye level, with a shallow depth of field that keeps the women in sharp focus while gently blurring the background. The overall style is modern, minimalistic, and fashion-forward, with a hint of surrealism due to the vivid hair color and the sense of motion frozen in time.
